rows.grounds: past participle of dah in accusative
past participle of vikalp in nominative

items.question: How does meditating on the world as burned transform imagination?
premises: The whole world is meditated as burned.
items.inference: Meditating on all world as burned yields imagined recognition.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of vikalpitaḥ remains open.
items.plain_english: Thus, having meditated on the entire world as burned, one is imagined.
